summary.headline: Zodiac Coordinates and Divisions
summary.text: Explanation of zodiac-sign notation in planetary position tables, including the sign, degree, minute, and the 360-degree division of the zodiac into degrees, minutes, and seconds. The text then distinguishes planets from fixed stars.
